title: The 10 Best Stand Mixers Under $300
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for stand mixers under $300, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at stand mixers under $300 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Cuisinart SM-50CRM Precision Master 5.5-Qt. 12-Speed Stand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: 500W motor with 12-speed control, 5.5-quart stainless bowl, tilt-head design, Die-cast zinc body with lever-lock tilt-head.
strengths: 500W motor outmuscles the KitchenAid Artisan's 325W on stiff dough and double batches
5.5-quart bowl handles double cookie batches and single bread loaves without strain
12 speeds give finer low-end control than the Artisan's 10
limitations: Attachment ecosystem is much smaller than KitchenAid's, cannot use KitchenAid pasta rollers or grinders
Tilt-head design has less overhead clearance on some counter setups
Fewer color options than KitchenAid (5 to 8 vs.
features: Die-cast zinc body with lever-lock tilt-head
Flat beater, dough hook, and wire whisk included
$200 to $280 retail, frequently discounted to $160 to $200

products.name: KitchenAid KSM3311XBM Artisan Mini 3.5-Qt. Tilt-Head
products.blurb: Key specs: 250W motor with 10-speed control, 3.5-quart stainless bowl, tilt-head design, Compatible with the full KitchenAid attachment hub.
strengths: Full KitchenAid attachment compatibility and motor quality in a smaller, less expensive body
30+ color options match the full-size Artisan's selection
limitations: 3.5-quart bowl limits batch size, not for large batches or stiff dough
250W is the least powerful motor in the KitchenAid consumer lineup
features: Compatible with the full KitchenAid attachment hub
20% smaller footprint than the full-size Artisan

products.name: Hamilton Beach 63325 3.5-Qt. Stand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: 300W motor with tilt-head design, 3.5-quart stainless bowl, Flat beater, dough hook, and wire whip included.
strengths: Handles standard cake and cookie recipes reliably at a fraction of KitchenAid's price
Tilt-head access and included attachments cover the core tasks most home bakers need
limitations: 300W peak rating means sustained output is considerably lower, heavy dough triggers cooling pauses
Not suited for regular or stiff bread dough
No meaningful attachment ecosystem beyond the three included pieces
features: Flat beater, dough hook, and wire whip included

products.name: Cuisinart SM-70 7-Qt. 12-Speed Stand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: 500W motor with bowl-lift design, 7-quart stainless bowl, 12 speeds.
strengths: 7-quart bowl-lift capacity at a price well below KitchenAid's equivalent bowl-lift models
500W motor handles large batches without the strain a tilt-head at this size would show
12 speeds give finer control than most bowl-lift competitors at this price
limitations: Bowl-lift height requires more overhead counter clearance than a tilt-head
Cuisinart's attachment ecosystem for this hub is far smaller than KitchenAid's
features: Dough hook, flat beater, and whisk included

products.name: Bosch Universal Plus Stand Mixer MUM6N10UC
products.blurb: Key specs: 500W motor with bowl-drive (motor-in-base) mechanism, 6.5-quart stainless bowl, holds 8 cups of flour, Spiral dough hook, balloon whisk, and cookie paddles included.
strengths: 500W bowl-drive motor handles 8 cups of flour continuously without overheating
6.5-quart bowl and bowl-drive geometry outperform any KitchenAid at this price for bread
Costs less than a comparably capable KitchenAid bowl-lift despite more power
limitations: Small attachment ecosystem compared to KitchenAid
1-year limited warranty versus KitchenAid's longer coverage
Colors limited to white and red
features: 6.5-quart stainless bowl, holds 8 cups of flour
Spiral dough hook, balloon whisk, and cookie paddles included

products.name: Hamilton Beach 63227N Die-Cast Metal Classic 4.5-Qt. Stand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: 400W motor with die-cast metal body, 4.5-quart stainless bowl, tilt-head design, Flat beater, dough hook, and wire whip included.
strengths: Die-cast metal body feels sturdier than the plastic-bodied competitors at this price
400W provides more headroom than Hamilton Beach's own 300W entry model

No compatible attachment ecosystem beyond what's included
features: Flat beater, dough hook, and wire whip included

products.name: Hamilton Beach 4-Quart 7-Speed Stand Mixer

strengths: 4-quart bowl at a low price point delivers solid capacity per dollar
Tilt-head design makes bowl access straightforward for everyday baking

Plastic housing feels less substantial than the die-cast 63227N model

products.name: Kenwood Chef Major Titanium KMM020 7-Qt.
products.blurb: Key specs: 1000W motor with bowl-lift design, 7-quart stainless bowl, K-beater, dough hook, and whisk included.

Titanium-reinforced gearbox is built for sustained heavy use beyond typical household duty cycles

Bowl-lift height requires substantial overhead counter clearance
features: K-beater, dough hook, and whisk included

products.name: Smeg 50's Retro Style Stand Mixer

Distinctive retro styling and gloss finish stand out on the counter compared to utilitarian competitors
4.7-quart bowl handles standard double batches comfortably

features: Retro-styled die-cast body in multiple gloss finishes

products.name: Cuisinart SM-55BC 5.5-Qt. Stand Mixer Precision Master
products.blurb: Key specs: 500W motor with 12-speed control, 5.5-quart stainless bowl, tilt-head design, Flat beater, dough hook, and wire whisk included.
strengths: Same 500W motor and 5.5-quart capacity as the SM-50 in an alternate finish and price point
Die-cast construction matches KitchenAid-level build quality at a lower price
limitations: Functionally near-identical to the SM-50, little reason to choose it unless the finish is preferred
Smaller attachment ecosystem than KitchenAid
Fewer color and finish options than KitchenAid's 30+
features: Flat beater, dough hook, and wire whisk included
